editRoles.title: Edit roles
editRoles.primaryHint: The primary role sets the home page and what the person sees first. A user has one primary role.
editRoles.primaryDaysKept: The chosen primary role keeps its recorded start and end dates; they are not changed here. To change them, make it an additional role.
editRoles.additionalHint: The effective permissions are those of the primary role plus the additional roles.
editRoles.privilegedNeedsCode: Changing privileged roles (Organization Admin, HR Manager, Finance Manager, Compliance Officer, Auditor) needs a code from an authenticator app; this becomes available once multi-factor authentication is set up. You can change the other roles now.
editRoles.privilegedAdminOnly: Only the Organization Admin changes privileged roles (Organization Admin, HR Manager, Finance Manager, Compliance Officer, Auditor).
editRoles.daysHint: A role starts at the beginning of its first day and ends at the end of its last day, in the organization's time zone. Leave a date empty for a role that starts now or does not end.
editRoles.audited: Every role change is recorded in the audit log with the values before and after the change.
editRoles.noChanges: There are no changes to save.
editRoles.lastAdmin: The organization must keep at least one active Organization Admin without an end date.
editRoles.datesInvalid: The end date must not be before the start date, and dates must be between 2000 and 2100.

blocked.own_roles: You can't change your own roles. The Organization Admin or HR changes them.
blocked.no_account: This person has no sign-in account in the organization; roles are chosen when they are invited.
blocked.revoked: This person's membership was revoked, so their roles can't be changed.
